Samuells writes: “They call themselves Juanga.” The neighboring term Puttooa is expressly attributed to their neighbours.

Samuells says that “One and all call themselves Pudhan”, and identifies it as “the title which the Ooriyas give to the headman of a village”. He illustrates its use in the personal name Moolee Pudhan. This is an attributed account of a title in use, not an independently established etymology.
